stage: offline diagnosis, not a novelty or latency claim
score: ascending-dimension RN-FP64 squared L2, separate multiply/add; no FMA/reassociation; inherited original score cache
certificate: max of independent conservative Euclidean box lower bounds; strict LB > sqrt(U_squared); no cross-view sum
packing: eight pairs FP32 lo/hi, no per-view padding; whole region 64B
PCA32_fit: all 1M rows, block 8192, same old mean/covariance/eigh four-thread procedure; mean and covariance hashes must reproduce old build; signs standardized; no queries/U/labels used
random: numpy 1.26.4 default_rng seed 20261012; layouts 2x4 then 4x2 then 8x1; independent QR(960,k) per view in ascending view order; per-view conservative exact-rational certification; no seed sweep

matrix.aliases: D1 layouts all alias PCA_BLOCKS; D2 8x1 aliases PCA_BLOCKS 8x1

gates.promotion: same L3/L4: hard>=0.55, hard gain>=0.15, worst>=0.25
gates.strong: same L3/L4 strong inequalities in plan; precedence strong then signal
gates.K1: all 11 distinct multi configurations across L3/L4/L5 have hard gain<0.05
gates.K2: at least one L3/L4 cell with hard gain>=0.10 and worst gain<0.05, if no promotion
gates.K3: at least one configuration with L5 hard gain>=0.10 and both its L3/L4 gains<0.10, if no promotion/K1/K2
gates.arithmetic: exact integer Fraction ratios for gate tests; no rounding before thresholds

lookahead.parents: P2 parent depths 2 and 3; eight per depth via independent np.default_rng(20261012) choice sorted; never query selection
lookahead.comparator: choose first proposal by immediate hard6 pruning then best split of each child; same grandchildren horizon as lookahead
lookahead.normalizer: 6 * parent object count, full-scan pruning fraction; paired sum counts over frozen parents; separate depth summaries
lookahead.closed: gain<0.10 pooled and at each sampled depth
lookahead.open: gain>=0.15 pooled or at a sampled depth; separate future direction only
lookahead.scope: finite sampled two-level proposal oracle, not global coordination upper bound

figure_selection: Figs2/3 all distinct 2x4 families (PCA_BLOCKS,INTERLEAVED,SPREAD32,RANDOM) at L4, all eight queries; never pick best-result configuration
resources: CPU-only CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; PCA four NUMA-local cores nice10 BLAS4 then projection/evaluation/lookahead one core BLAS1; task-owned advisory lock; 900s each phase; no foreign signals
